verdict.rationale: Qdrant's own snapshot feature packages a collection's data and configuration into a documented tar archive, so it counts as a native, if coarse, bulk-export path. The pack shows no evidence of restoring snapshots, batch-upserting points, or exporting to interchange formats. missing for 10: documented bulk import/restore path, batch upsert API evidence, interchange export formats (e.g. JSON/Parquet/CSV) for vectors plus payload, hands-on corroboration of import/export workflows

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-import and bulk-export vectors plus metadata in documented formats

citations.quote: Snapshots are tar archive files that contain data and configuration of a specific collection on a specific node at a specific time.
store, search, and manage points—vectors with an additional payload
